title: LUT-HD: Accelerating Hyperdimensional Computing Inference via Efficient Table Lookup
problem: Hyperdimensional computing encoding and associative search phases are computationally expensive and resource-intensive, limiting deployment on edge devices.
motivation: Enable efficient HDC inference on resource-constrained platforms for robust cognitive computing applications.
method: Software-hardware co-design with binary code quantization (BCQ) algorithm using lookup tables to transform matrix-vector multiplications into table lookups; custom FPGA-based accelerator with optimized pipeline for encoding and associative search.
key_novelty: Table lookup-based acceleration of HDC matrix-vector multiplications with minimal accuracy loss.
contributions: Binary code quantization (BCQ) algorithm with lookup table acceleration
Custom FPGA accelerator tailored for LUT-based HDC
Performance-optimized pipeline for encoding and associative search

metrics.speedup: 14.6× vs GPU, 5.5× over SOTA HDC solutions
metrics.energy_or_tops_w: 97.3% energy reduction vs GPU, 44.8% vs SOTA HDC

limitations: LUT-based quantization may limit accuracy for applications requiring high precision.
